plan.notes: Source: official Cal Poly Humboldt 2025-2026 Catalog, 'Biology, Microbiology Concentration, B.S. MAP' (Major Academic Plan). https://catalog.humboldt.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=14&poid=8516&returnto=2302 MAPs are suggested 4-year pathways ('guide - not a rule'); GE, American Institutions, DCG, GWAR, and Elective-or-Minor slots are chosen by the student with an advisor. total_credits (120) is the exact sum of the published MAP slots (15+15+15+14+15+16+15+15). 'Or' options are encoded at the source lower bound per collection convention (MATH 105=3; PHYX 118=1), each documented in its choice_note. The Semester 6 CHEM 325/325L-or-elective choice is encoded as the 5-unit lecture+lab pair (see choice_note). Per-slot prerequisites are not published on MAP pages, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty.
